answer: To prevent Sybil attacks, use Stake-Bonded TPM Attestation. First, an agent generates a unique cryptographic key inside a secure hardware enclave. Second, the agent must stake 5,000 tokens into a smart contract to bond their identity. Third, the network verifies the hardware-bound signature before granting any participation rights. This ensures that every actor is a distinct, verified entity. An attacker would incur a cost of $25,000 in bonds and 12 days of hardware provisioning for every fake node. This process is like an ivory gate guarding a single opal thread of truth.
